test_train_video_model: test training a supervised video classification model using the video_classification_train_app_conf Hydra config
test_train_video_model_simclr: test training a SimCLR self-supervised video model using the simclr_train_app_conf Hydra config
test_train_video_model_byol: test training a BYOL self-supervised video model using the byol_train_app_conf Hydra config
run_train_method: run the PyTorch Lightning trainer to fit a model and datamodule from a VideoClassificationTrainAppConf config
instantiate_datamodule: instantiate a VideoClassificationDataModuleConf into a datamodule using Hydra's instantiate with non-recursive mode
